The pilot’s failure to maintain the proper glidepath during final approach in night visual meteorological conditions, which resulted in a collision with trees.
The pilot's failure to maintain directional control during takeoff.
The failure of the left main landing gear retraction brace assembly, resulting in the collapse of the left main landing gear.

The pilot's misidentification of the airport’s active runway, which resulted in an off runway landing and a collision with a snow berm. Contributing to the accident was the runway’s lack of identifying markings.
A loss of directional control on takeoff, which resulted in the collapse of the nose wheel strut and a runway excursion.

A total loss of engine power during cruise for reasons that could not be determined based on the available information. Contributing to the accident was the pilot’s loss of control during the forced landing.
